es.summary: Recién nacido a las 42 semanas de gestación o después. El embarazo prolongado aumenta el riesgo de oligohidramnios, meconio y sufrimiento fetal.
key_points: Postérmino: embarazo que pasa de las 42 semanas y 0 días.
La placenta envejece y su función disminuye: puede haber insuficiencia útero-placentaria.
Riesgos fetales: oligohidramnios, líquido meconial, aspiración de meconio y macrosomía.
Signos del RN posmaduro: piel arrugada, seca y descamada (sin vérnix), uñas largas y aspecto delgado.

usage: Ejemplo: «RN post de 42 2/7 semanas, líquido meconial ++».
El embarazo postérmino es indicación de inducción del parto.
nursing_care: En el parto, vigilar la FCF: desaceleraciones tardías (insuficiencia placentaria) y variables (compresión del cordón).
Anotar el color del líquido amniótico; prepararse para un RN con líquido meconial.
Vigilar la glucemia y la dificultad respiratoria en el RN.
Hidratar y proteger la piel descamada.

en.summary: A newborn born at or after 42 weeks of gestation (RN post in Spanish). A prolonged pregnancy raises the risk of oligohydramnios, meconium and fetal compromise.
key_points: A pregnancy extending past 42 weeks and 0 days is considered postterm.
The placenta has limited capacity: uteroplacental insufficiency can occur.
Fetal risks: oligohydramnios, meconium-stained fluid, meconium aspiration and macrosomia.
Postmature newborn signs: wrinkled, peeling skin without vernix caseosa, long nails and a wasted-looking body.

usage: Postterm pregnancy is an indication for induction of labor.
nursing_care: During labor, watch the FHR for late decelerations (uteroplacental insufficiency) and variable decelerations (cord compression).
Document the color of the amniotic fluid and be ready for a newborn with meconium-stained fluid.
Monitor the newborn's blood glucose and breathing.
Moisturize and protect the peeling skin.

sources.name: Maternal-Newborn Nursing: Obstetrical Conditions Affecting Labor and Birth

summary.0.quote: Infants born after 42 weeks are considered postmature.

key_points.0.quote: A pregnancy extending past 42 weeks and 0 days is considered postterm (ACOG, 2014).

key_points.1.quote: Some research suggests the placenta has limited capacity and leads to postmaturity syndrome when the pregnancy progresses past term (Patel & Rathod, 2022).

key_points.2.quote: Table 19.9 lists the adverse outcomes of postterm birth.

key_points.3.quote: Skin of the hands and feet are wrinkled and peeling due to lack of vernix caseosa.

sections.nursing_care.0.quote: The nurse will recognize FHR late decelerations because of uteroplacental insufficiency and variable decelerations because of cord compression.
